```{r}

table4a
```

```{r}
#| paged.print: false
tidy4a <- table4a %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -country,
    names_to = "year", 
    values_to = "cases")
tidy4a
```

```{r}
#| paged.print: false
tidy4a <- table4a %>% 
  mutate(
    `1999` = as.character(`1999`),
    `2000` = as.character(`2000`),
  ) |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = country:`2000`,
    names_to = "year", 
    values_to = "cases")
tidy4a
```


### Separate

```{r}
tidy3 <- table3 %>% 
  separate(col = rate,
           into = c("cases", "pop"),
           sep = "/"
           )
```


```{r}
#| paged.print: false
tidy3century <- tidy3 %>% 
  separate(col = year,
           into = c("century", "year"),
           sep = 2
           )
tidy3century
```

### Unite

```{r}
#| paged.print: false
tidy3century %>% 
  unite(
    col = year,
    century, year, # the columns we want to unite
    sep = "" # what happens witout sep?
  )
```

### Missing values

```{r}
stocks <- tibble(
  year   = c(2015, 2015, 2015, 
             2015, 2016, 2016, 2016),
  qtr    = c(   1,    2,    3,    
                4,    2,    3,    4),
  return = c(1.88, 0.59, 0.35,
             NA, 0.92, 0.17, 2.66)
)
```

```{r}
#| paged.print: false
# explicitly missing and implicitly missing
stocks
```

```{r}
#| paged.print: false
stocks_wider <- stocks %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = year,
    values_from = return
    )
stocks_wider
```

```{r}
#| paged.print: false
stocks_wider <- stocks %>% 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = year,
    names_prefix = "y",
    values_from = return
    )
stocks_wider
```

```{r}
#| paged.print: false
stocks_wider %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -qtr,
    names_to = "year", # in quote since it does not exist yet
    values_to = "return",
    values_drop_na = TRUE,
    names_prefix = "y"
  ) %>% 
  arrange(year, qtr)
```

```{r}
#| paged.print: false
stocks %>% 
  complete(year, qtr)
```

### fill

```{r}
#| paged.print: false
treatment <- tribble(
  ~ person,           ~ treatment, ~response,
  "Derrick Whitmore", 1,           7,
  NA,                 2,           10,
  NA,                 3,           9,
  "Katherine Burke",  1,           4
)
treatment
```

```{r}
#| paged.print: false
treatment %>% 
  fill(
    person, 
    .direction = c("down")
    )
```

```{r}
#| paged.print: false
treatment %>% 
  fill(
    person, 
    .direction = c("up")
    )
```


```{r}
#| eval: false
#| paged.print: false
treatmentB <- treatment
treatmentB[2,2] <- NA
treatmentB[3,2] <- NA
treatmentB
```

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| paged.print: false
treatment %>% 
  fill(
    c(person, treatment),
    .direction = c("down", "up")
    )
```

### WHO

```{r}
dim(who)
```

```{r}
#| eval: false
View(who)
```

```{r}
#| paged.print: false
who <- who %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = new_sp_m014:newrel_f65,
    names_to = "key",
    values_to = "cases",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
    )
who
```

```{r}
who <- who %>% 
  mutate(
    key = str_replace(key, "newrel", "new_rel")
  )
```

```{r}
#| paged.print: false
who |> 
  tail()
```

```{r}
View(who)
```

```{r}
# Fjerner new_
who <- who %>% 
  mutate(
    key = str_replace(key, "new_", "")
  )
```

```{r}
#| paged.print: false
who <- who %>% 
  separate(col = key,
           into = c("type", "sexage"),
           sep = "_"
           )
who
```

```{r}
#| paged.print: false
who <- who %>% 
  select(-iso2, -iso3) %>% 
  separate(col = sexage,
           into = c("sex", "age"),
           sep = 1
           )
who
```

```{r}
who <- who %>% 
  mutate(
    age = str_pad(age, width = 4, side = "left", pad = "0"),
    age = str_replace(age, "0065", "6599")
  ) %>% 
  separate(col = age,
           into = c("age_start", "age_end"),
           sep = 2
           )
```

```{r}
#| paged.print: false
who
```
